lastHandoff.summary: Ship one external, immutable-cached CSS file instead of inlining the stylesheet into every page.
lastHandoff.reason: The compiled stylesheet is ~120KB (Tailwind v4 color-mix fallbacks alone are 30KB). Inlining it made every page uncacheable and repeated the same bytes on every navigation, and pushed average HTML to 174KB for crawlers. A hashed /_astro/*.css with max-age=31536000 already has the right caching headers.

decisions.summary: Use repository-owned project memory before adding Graphiti.
decisions.reason: The repo already contains state.json, Mission Control, SQLite SEO memory, and agent rules; a graph service would add another state store and database dependency before the handoff contract is stable.
Only one article may be made live in a session; all other article work remains draft-only until human review.
